questions.question: Which data structure in Python is mutable and can store elements of different data types?
questions.hint: This structure is represented by square brackets `[]`.
questions.rationale: A list in Python is an ordered, mutable sequence that can hold elements of various data types.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid ways to create a comment in Python?
questions.hint: Python uses a specific symbol for single-line comments and triple quotes for multi-line comments.
questions.rationale: The `#` symbol is used for single-line comments. Triple single quotes `'''` or triple double quotes `"""` are used for multi-line comments or docstrings.
